Stranded aboard a derelict research vessel at the edge of known space, a lone astronaut battles a rapidly deteriorating mind as strange, impossible echoes begin to haunt the ship's empty corridors. Cut off from Earth and running out of oxygen, she must decipher whether the creeping shadows are a symptom of her isolation or something far more sinister waiting in the dark. With every passing hour, the boundary between reality and hallucination blurs, turning the vast emptiness of the cosmos into her ultimate prison.
